| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Most keypoints** `maxFeatures` | 0 | 0 to 5000 | Keep at most this many keypoints, the strongest. 0 keeps all. |
| **Layers per octave** `octaveLayers` | 3 | 1 to 8 | The number of scales in each octave, where the size doubles. Lowe uses 3. |
| **Contrast threshold** `contrastThreshold` | 0.04 | 0.001 to 0.2 | Weak extrema in flat areas are dropped. OpenCV divides this by the number of layers. |
| **Edge threshold** `edgeThreshold` | 10 | 1 to 50 | The largest ratio r of the two curvatures. Points on edges, where one curvature is much larger, are dropped. Lowe uses 10. |
| **Sigma** `sigma` | 1.6 | 0.5 to 5 px | The blur of the first scale. Lowe uses 1.6. |
